actions.description: Add a member to a team
actions.name: add-team-member

teamId.description: Team ID to add the member to. Example: "ee0f5ae2-8bc6-4ae5-8466-7daeebbfa062"

userId.description: User ID or user principal name (UPN) to add as a member. Example: "8b081ef6-4792-4def-b2c9-c363a1bf41d5" or "jacob@contoso.com"

isOwner.description: Whether to add the user as an owner. Defaults to false (regular member).

actions.description: Post a root message in a channel
actions.name: create-channel-message

content.description:
Message content in HTML or plain text. Example: "

Hello team!

"

contentType.description: MIME type of the attachment. Example: "application/vnd.microsoft.card.hero"

actions.description: Add a tab to a channel.
actions.name: create-channel-tab

displayName.description: Display name for the tab. Example: "My Tab"

teamsAppOdataBind.description: OData bind reference to the Teams app. Example: "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/appCatalogs/teamsApps/com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.web"

entityId.description: Entity ID for the tab content

contentUrl.description: Content URL for the tab. Example: "https://www.example.com/content"

websiteUrl.description: Website URL for the tab. Example: "https://www.example.com"

actions.description: Create a channel in a team.
actions.name: create-channel

teamId.description: The ID of the team to create the channel in. Example: "19:xxxxxxxxxxxx"

displayName.description: The display name of the channel. Example: "General"

membershipType.description: The type of the channel. Defaults to standard.

actions.description: Send a message in a chat
actions.name: create-chat-message

chatId.description: The unique identifier of the chat. Example: "19:2da4c29f6d7041eca70b638b43d45437@thread.v2"

contentType.description: Content type of the message body

content.description:
Content of the message body in plain text or HTML format. Example: "

Hello world

"

body.description: The body of the chat message

actions.description: Create a one-on-one or group chat.
actions.name: create-chat

chatType.description: The type of chat. oneOnOne for 1:1 chats, group for group chats.

topic.description: The topic or title of the chat. Required for group chats.

userId.description: The Azure AD user ID of the member. Example: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"

roles.description: Roles for this member. Use "owner" to grant ownership; omit or pass [] for a regular member.

members.description: List of members to add to the chat. Must include at least one member for group chats.

id.description: The unique identifier of the chat.

actions.description: Create a team from a template or existing group.
actions.name: create-team

display_name.description: Display name of the team. Example: "My Sample Team"

template.description: Template ID or name. Example: "standard" or "educationClass". Defaults to "standard".

first_channel_name.description: Name of the first (General) channel. Defaults to "General".

group_id.description: Existing group ID to create the team from. If provided, team is created from this group.

members.description: Members to add to the team. Required for application permissions.

user_id.description: User ID to add as a member. Example: "0040b377-61d8-43db-94f5-81374122dc7e"

channels.description: Channels to create with the team.

is_favorite_by_default.description: Whether the channel is favorited by default.

tabs.description: Tabs to install in the channel.

installed_apps.description: Apps to install in the team.

teams_app_id.description: Teams app ID to install. Example: "com.microsoft.teamspace.tab.vsts"

team_id.description: ID of the created team (available after operation succeeds).

operation_url.description: URL to poll for operation status.

error.description: Error details if the operation failed.

actions.description: Delete a channel from a team
actions.name: delete-channel

teamId.description: The unique identifier of the team. Example: "19:1234567890abcdef@thread.tacv2"

channelId.description: The unique identifier of the channel. Example: "19:abcdef1234567890@thread.tacv2"

channelId.description: The unique identifier of the channel. Example: "19:561fbdbbfca848a484f0a6f00ce9dbbd@thread.tacv2"

actions.name: get-chat-message

messageId.description: The ID of the chat message to retrieve. Example: "1659458708524"

actions.description: List root messages in a channel.
actions.name: list-channel-messages

team_id.description: Team ID. Example: "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890". Required when next_link is not provided.

channel_id.description: Channel ID. Example: "19:abc123@thread.tacv2". Required when next_link is not provided.

next_link.description: Pagination cursor (@odata.nextLink) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List replies under a channel message thread
actions.name: list-channel-replies

messageId.description: Parent message ID to fetch replies for. Example: "1234567890"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (full @odata.nextLink URL) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor to fetch the next page. Pass this as the cursor input in the next request.

actions.description: List tabs configured on a channel.

teamId.description: The ID of the team. Example: "6903fa93-605b-43ef-920e-77c4729f8258"

channelId.description: The ID of the channel. Example: "19:33b76eea88574bd1969dca37e2b7a819@thread.skype"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (@odata.nextLink). Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List channels in a team.

teamId.description: The unique identifier of the team. Example: "893075dd-2487-4122-925f-022c42e20265"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (@odata.nextLink). Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List members in a chat
actions.name: list-chat-members

chat_id.description: The unique identifier of the chat. Example: "19:xxxxx@thread.v2"

cursor.description: Full URL from @odata.nextLink for pagination. Omit for the first page.

actions.description: List messages in a chat.
actions.name: list-chat-messages

chatId.description: The unique identifier of the chat. Example: "19:2da4c29f6d7041eca70b638b43d45437@thread.v2"

cursor.description: Pagination cursor (full @odata.nextLink URL) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

top.description: Maximum number of messages to return per page (1-50). Default is determined by the API.

nextLink.description: Full URL for the next page. Pass this value as the cursor input for the next request.
